articles.title: Europe’s wildfire crisis eases in west as danger shifts east to Greece - AP News
articles.description: Firefighters have contained a vast wildfire in southwestern France, allowing nearly 200,000 people to return home. The development comes after what may have been the country’s largest peacetime evacuation. However, renewed fires have forced thousands from the…
